task: Once you have found the key, the locked door must be open on the last step of the episode. Open it, then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The Existence(target_picked_up) makes the pickup a hard goal; Response(has_matching_key, target_door_open) keeps the door open after the key is taken (note target_door_open is a condition that persists through the last step, so the requirement holds); Precedence(target_door_open, target_picked_up) with the hard Existence captures 'open it, then pick up the ball' and forces the door opening. The clauses jointly express the task.
